definition: Eloquens, (commonly known under the alias Er Finestra) is a text-to-speech software, whose first version was released in 1993 by CSELT.
details: It was the first commercial speech synthesis software able to speak Italian.

explainer.lead: Eloquens, also known as Er Finestra, is a text-to-speech program that turns written text into spoken Italian. Released by CSELT in 1993, it was the first commercial speech-synthesis software able to speak Italian.

tiers.eli5: Eloquens works like a person reading Italian words aloud from a page, except the reader is a computer program. You give it writing, and it gives you speech.
tiers.practitioner: Treat Eloquens as a historical Italian text-to-speech product with a text-in, speech-out application boundary. Do not confuse it with speech recognition or assume modern interfaces, audio formats, or voice controls without product documentation. Its alias, Er Finestra, is useful when matching older product references.
tiers.paperLevel: Formally, Eloquens performs text-to-speech synthesis: f(t) = s, where t is written text and s is synthesized speech. Its documented significance is historical: CSELT released the first version in 1993, and it was the first commercial speech-synthesis software able to speak Italian.

explainer.example: Given the text “Buongiorno,” Eloquens produces a synthesized spoken Italian greeting.

usedIn.name: Italian-language speech synthesis
usedIn.detail: Turns written Italian into spoken output.

usedIn.name: Commercial speech software
usedIn.detail: Marked the first commercial speech-synthesis product capable of speaking Italian.

explainer.intuition: Eloquens acts as a digital Italian reader: text goes in, and synthesized speech comes out.
howItWorks: The program produces spoken Italian output.
explainer.whyItMatters: Its 1993 release made Italian-language speech synthesis commercially available for the first time. It is therefore a milestone in the development of Italian text-to-speech technology.
misconceptions: It is not speech recognition: it converts text into speech, not speech into text.
Er Finestra is an alias for Eloquens, not a separate program.
It was the first commercial Italian speech-synthesis software, not the first text-to-speech system of any kind.
